game.core.engine-test/trash-currents-tes.nativeTitle: playing a Runner current trashes the Corp current (CR 3.5.1b)
game.core.engine-test/trash-currents-tes.reason: Playing a current only trashed the playing side's currents. CR 3.5.1b and CR 3.7.1b end a current when another current operation or event is played, whichever side plays it. The engine fix carries native tests in tests/currents.test.ts for both directions; these ports keep the full score/steal/replacement boards.

game.core.costs-test/pump-and-break.nativeTitle: Houdini pumps twice on Mantle's recurring credits and reaches 10 strength (CR 1.10.5a)
game.core.costs-test/pump-and-break.reason: The inability-to-pay and stealth blocks are ported. The engine spends stealth credits automatically when a cost is paid, so the stealth block pumps twice without upstream's source-choice prompt; that block exposed that recurring credits on stealth cards did not count as credits from a stealth card, fixed in the engine with the promoted native test named here. The three Hive full-break blocks wait on the pinned cards catalog, which lists 4 of Hive's 5 printed End the run subroutines; those blocks assert a 5-subroutine board the pin cannot produce.
game.core.costs-test/pump-and-break.blockedNote: The three Hive full-break blocks wait on the pinned catalog, which lists 4 of Hive's 5 printed End the run subroutines.
